_what: What read-data/personal-data.mjs looks for in words before they go to a model that is not on this Mac (tool:check-personal-data). `patterns` are shapes found by rule (regular expressions; `luhn` also requires a valid card checksum). `model_questions` are yes-or-no questions put to a model on this Mac (tools/ask-a-small-model-for-a-verdict answer-state-questions.mjs, at the `model` the input names) about the whole text; one at or above `threshold` counts. `choices` are what the person is offered when something is found: send it as it is, do the job on this Mac only (tool:ask-a-model, the Mac app's own tool in Trillion computer/local-models.mjs), or keep it back. Nothing leaves this Mac to run this check.

model_questions.instructions: Does this text contain a real person's full name together with their home address?
Does this text contain a real person's medical or health details?

choices.label: Do it on this Mac only

words.needs_text: Give the words to check as text.
words.model_unchecked: The model on this Mac did not answer, so only the shapes found by rule were checked: {why}
words.clean: Nothing that looks like personal data was found.
words.no_model: no model on this computer was named
